items.quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
items.why: Quote states auth is OAuth 2.0 user access tokens, matching oauth2 claim.

items.quote: Short-lived tokens that have not expired can be exchanged for long-lived access tokens, which are valid for 60 days.
items.why: Describes token exchange to 60-day tokens, consistent with oauth2 but not naming the auth method.

items.quote: For app users without a role on your app to grant your app these permissions, each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published.
items.why: Quote states non-role users need App Review approval and published app, the gate claimed.

items.quote: Threads testers can grant your app these permissions at any time.
items.why: Testers granting permissions is the dev-mode role path; implies a gate but doesn't state approval requirement.

items.quote: Threads profiles are limited to 250 API-published posts within a rolling 24-hour period.
items.why: Consistent with the 250/24h limit detail; says nothing on REST style or breadth.

items.quote: `threads_manage_insights` — Required for making `GET` calls to insights endpoints.
items.why: Scope note for insights GET calls; supports insights being in scope, not the overall REST breadth.
